subject: Plotting Cumulative Score Category Functions for GRMs

messages.author: d0b18666fe8582cb
messages.subject: Plotting Cumulative Score Category Functions for GRMs
parts:
Hi Phil,

Hope all is well. I am wondering if there is a way to create empirical plots of cumulative score category functions using the itemfit function (or another mirt function) for items scaled with a unidimensional graded response model? In the itemfit function, I am only able to create empirical plots of the score category functions vs cumulative score category functions. The latter would be helpful in being able to see if there is any misfit due to violation of the assumption of equal slopes across categories; and also would love to be able to use the CI function built into itemfit for dichotomous items on the plotted cumulative score category functions if possible. Any thoughts are much appreciated.

Thank you,
Keri

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Plotting Cumulative Score Category Functions for GRMs

Hi Keri,

Interesting idea. mirt doesn't currently support this feature, but it could in the future. I'll add it to the long list of TODOs of future features. 

Phil
